# Future Ammunition - MXA2

`jmfsb_fa_mxa2`

Gives Frogtop's MXA2 (workshop: Alternative MX - MXA2) ACE barrel figures - 14in 355.6 mm with the MX's twist, 10in 254 mm with the MXC's - so the FA 6.5 mm velocity tables tell the two barrels apart. Loads only when the MXA2 does.

<!-- generated below this line by tools/gen_addon_readmes.py - do not edit -->

## Requires

- `jmfsb_fa_main`
- `weapons_MXA2_f` _(external)_

Carries `skipWhenMissingDependencies` - the PBO is skipped rather than breaking the load order when something above is absent.
